data.one_liner: Automatically persist and restore MobX state stores.
data.what_it_does: Extends MobX state management library to automatically persist and restore store states across app restarts. It supports schema migration, write coalescing, multiple storage boxes, and eviction strategies.
use_when: You are using MobX for state management and need to persist store states.
You need advanced features like write coalescing, schema migration, and eviction for your persisted stores.
avoid_when: You use a different state management library like Riverpod or Bloc.
You only need simple key-value storage without state management integration.
strengths: Automatic persistence and restoration of MobX stores
Write coalescing and change detection to reduce redundant disk writes
Comprehensive error handling and testing utilities
weaknesses: Tightly coupled to the MobX state management library
Requires careful storage prefix management to avoid data loss on class renaming
data.setup_notes: Initialize HydratedStorage with a directory before calling runApp.

alternatives.name: flutter_bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to use BLoC state management with built-in persistence via hydrated_bloc instead of MobX.

alternatives.name: flutter_riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer Riverpod for state management and need a different persistence approach.
